scope: Independent reference calculation of P1 candidates and planned levels on the #4 audited resampled BTC perpetual history. No TakeProfit strategy fills or realized profitability are inferred.

reference_method.implementation: Separate JavaScript engine; not emitted from or imported by the Indie generator/template.
reference_method.entry_ema: SMA seed at length samples followed by alpha=2/(length+1), matching the documented Indie Ema source algorithm.
reference_method.atr: True range followed by Wilder RMA(14), initialized by the first 14-value SMA, matching the documented Indie Atr -> RMA algorithm.
reference_method.higher_timeframe: Execution bars grouped by UTC bucket; complete contiguous groups only; EMA20/EMA50 recursively updated from the first completed HTF close; slope uses three completed HTF bars.
reference_method.touch_model: Completed bars processed once in timestamp order; first eligible range intersection arms; eligibility checks touch bias and directional EMA50 closes only within the current recovery episode.
reference_method.time_model: Unix UTC seconds at bar opens; entry quote uses next execution candle open.
reference_method.known_fill_limit: No exchange order book, actual fills, fee tier, spread/slippage tape, or funding cash flows are included in this candidate parity report.

overall.actual_fills: not simulated; retained as unknown in every event row
overall.profitability: unproven; this report does not measure strategy returns or prove profitability
